hana: Monthly recurrence patterns scan in. Top signatures: CRIT-A, MEM-LEAK-1, ROUTER-THROTTLE, MODEL-DRIFT, DB-TIMEOUT. Need owners + concrete ETAs.

josh: I can pick MEM-LEAK-1 and ROUTER-THROTTLE. MEM-LEAK-1 needs a heap/profile run first; ETA for short-term mitigation 7d.

marta: I'll take CRIT-A and DB-TIMEOUT. CRIT-A short-term mitigation is disabling a failing feature flag; long-term is redesign (6w).

leo: I can help with MODEL-DRIFT long-term. Short-term: pin model variant and add score-based alerting.

incident-bot: Automated summary: pattern-scan run=2026-06-04; recurrences=26; signatures=[CRIT-A,MEM-LEAK-1,ROUTER-THROTTLE,MODEL-DRIFT,DB-TIMEOUT]; created followups PM-1511..PM-1515. Template: owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback.

hana: Please populate the tracker row (link in tracker) with owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback and include monitoring queries and rollback plan. Use conservative ETAs.

josh: MEM-LEAK-1 staging steps I ran: `python tools/heap_profile.py --sig MEM-LEAK-1 --duration 2h` and invalidated caches: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/cache/invalidate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"/models/mem/"}'`. Staging 6h no regressions. Will run 24h.

marta: For CRIT-A short-term I will flip FF-critA off: `/ops/flags toggle --flag=critA --state=off` and monitor. AC: no more than 1 recurrence in 30d and no customer-facing 5xx for 14d.

leo: MODEL-DRIFT short-term: pin variant `v2-stable` and add alert query `increase(model_score_drop_total{sig="MODEL-DRIFT"}[1d]) > 2`. Long-term design doc ETA 4w.

hana: Who will own weekly follow-ups and post Friday updates? Also note any blockers as ticket refs.

josh: I'll post Friday status updates for MEM-LEAK-1 and ROUTER-THROTTLE. Created ticket INF-9017 for heap profiling.

marta: DB-TIMEOUT requires capacity confirmation for additional read replicas. Filed CAP-9650. If capacity delayed, fallback is query-level timeouts + retry backoff.

incident-bot: Reminder: include acceptance criteria and monitoring queries. Example AC: "<=2 recurrences in 30d; alert to sev2 only". Use tracker as source of truth.

hana: Ok. Owners: add ETAs by EOD tomorrow. Infra/capacity teams, please respond to blockers within 48h or we'll escalate. I'll schedule a 20-min huddle Wed 9:30am PT if needed.

leo: Adding monitoring queries and runbook links to tracker now.

josh: Posting 24h staging logs to tracker link after run completes.

marta: Will add rollback plan for CRIT-A toggle and mark long-term design ticket.

hana: Thanks all. Closing thread for now  updates in tracker. If anything changes, ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
